name: Boarding pass
summary: A wallet-style boarding pass: from and to airport codes joined by a plane line, gate, seat, boarding time and group, the passenger, a drawn barcode and a notched tear line.
use: in a travel or airline app, for the pass a traveller shows at the gate
a11y: The pass is an article named by flight and route; gate, seat, boarding time and group are a description list, and the barcode is an image named with its booking code.
